Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{D}y{e}^{xy}\,\text{d}A,$ where 
$D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le 4}.$

feedback.problem:
Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{D}2\operatorname{sin}⁡y\operatorname{cos}⁡x\,\text{d}A,$ where 
$D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le \frac{\pi }{2},\,0\le y\le \frac{\pi }{4}}.$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we express our double integral as a repeated integral:    

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}2\operatorname{sin}⁡y\operatorname{cos}⁡x\,\text{d}A & ={\int }_{0}^{\pi /4}[{\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}2\operatorname{sin}⁡y\operatorname{cos}⁡x\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x$, treating $y$ as a constant:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{\pi /4}[{\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}2\operatorname{sin}⁡y\operatorname{cos}⁡x\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y & ={\int }_{0}^{\pi /4}2\operatorname{sin}⁡y\,[\operatorname{sin}⁡x]_{0}^{\pi /2}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\pi /4}2\operatorname{sin}⁡y(\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})-\operatorname{sin}⁡(0))\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\pi /4}2\operatorname{sin}⁡y(1-0)\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\pi /4}2\operatorname{sin}⁡y\,\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{\pi /4}2\operatorname{sin}⁡y\,\text{d}y & =-2[\operatorname{cos}⁡y]_{0}^{\pi /4} \\  & =-2(\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4})-\operatorname{cos}⁡(0)) \\  & =-2\cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}-2\cdot (-1) \\  & =2-\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}
$$
